templateReason: One of the largest Indian restaurants in Tabuk requires a grand, premium landing page that reflects the scale and heritage of Indian culinary tradition. The high review count (2,957) and strong rating (4.0) justify a premium custom build.
primaryGoals: Automate orders via WhatsApp to reduce waiter dependency
Clarify Indian dish ingredients and spice levels for unfamiliar diners
Showcase the grand scale and heritage of the restaurant
Drive group and family dining reservations
keyFeatures: Detailed menu with spice level indicators
Ingredient transparency for each dish category
Dark/light mode with rich Indian color palette
differentiator: Grander and more formal than Biryani House. Ornamental CSS borders, generous layout, rich jewel-tone palette. Emphasizes heritage, tradition, and scale.
